Saved. Both pieces are now persisted:

1. New reference file `calendar-year-receipts-vs-fiscal-year.md` with the concrete procedure.
2. A pointer entry in SKILL.md so future runs route to it.

Generalizable lesson captured: when a Treasury Bulletin question says "**calendar year**," the value must be the sum of the 12 monthly Jan–Dec cells, not the fiscal-year row (Jul–Jun). Grabbing the fiscal-year row for a calendar-year question produces a systematically-off ratio (my 0.4802 vs gold 0.6841, a clean ~0.70 scale error — digits not random, classic period-basis mismatch). Also reinforced: "national defense" is a budget *function* line not an agency, and "mean of the ratios" means averaging per-year ratios, not dividing the summed totals.

This is genuinely reusable across any calendar-year aggregation question, so the skill update was warranted.
